_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: The AD group-to-role table can live in the organization-layer repo (config/roles.json), read after a non-empty table in this machine's settings, and travels with the org layer's background sync; an unreadable table shows a degraded line at session start; memory-audit --move-distant removes the index entry and vector chunks and regenerates the catalog; vector_search.auto_start_service=false also stops the per-prompt re-kick; test runs no longer leave vector services behind and do not depend on the host's enabled plugins; atom-heal keeps shared project cards off personal-only repoint targets and keeps one diagnostic card per layer; the weekly health report summarizes the root-leak ledger
